name: City of Vancouver Empty Homes Tax
description: Municipal tax of 3% of assessed value on Class 1 residential property in the City of Vancouver that is empty for more than six months of the year (separate from the provincial speculation and vacancy tax).

attributes.applies_to: Class 1 residential property, City of Vancouver
attributes.pending_change: A September 2025 council motion proposed 5%; adoption not confirmed.
